brief: More CYMBA logos that feel like a proper technology product, with mature consumer-hardware typography and compact symbols.

concepts.name: Aperture
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one polished logo concept presentation for CYMBA, a premium consumer audio and neurotechnology hardware brand.
Primary request: create an original identity that feels like a credible, established technology product: confident, precise, distinctive and suitable for tiny hardware engraving, an app icon, packaging and a website header. Professional industrial design sensibility, simple robust geometry and excellent typography.
Style: flat vector-like graphic artwork, crisp clean outlines, single-colour marks. Charcoal #1d1d1f on an absolutely uniform cool white #f5f5f7 background.
Composition: landscape 3:2 presentation. One large primary horizontal logo centred in upper middle with generous clear space. Across the bottom quarter show a small scale version on the left and the same logo reversed in white inside one modest charcoal rectangular field on the right. All instances must use exactly the same design and letterforms. No extra labels, headlines, explanations or slogans.
Avoid: leaves, lotus, hearts, brains, literal ears, medical crosses, stock Wi-Fi symbols, infinity loops, circuit traces, microchips, hexagonal badges, crypto aesthetics, gaming graphics, sci-fi fonts, aggressive chamfers, stencil lettering, generic swooshes, gradients, drop shadows, textures, 3D, mockup objects, watermarks.
Design direction: APERTURE. A compact proprietary C symbol built from one bold near-circular band with subtly flattened top and bottom, a decisive right-hand opening, and two clean parallel terminal faces. Refine its proportions to feel like a carefully machined physical component. An asymmetrical but balanced opening distinguishes it from a default letter C; no inner dot, no power-button vertical bar, no extra rings. Medium-bold weight, open negative space, restrained corner radii, clean silhouette at 16 pixels.
Pair it with exact uppercase text "CYMBA" in a custom contemporary grotesk: medium-bold, natural width, clean unbroken letterforms, optical spacing, curved C and B, fully readable conventional M and A. Symbol on the left, wordmark on the right; icon approximately the capital height. Small-scale sample at bottom left is the standalone symbol. Strong premium audio engineering character, with carefully judged proportions.
concepts.review: Visually checked for legible brand text, unclipped geometry and light/dark presentation.

Design direction: COUPLED. Create a compact abstract symbol from exactly TWO solid shapes: two short broad rounded vertical rails, each with a subtle inward step near its centre, facing each other across an even open gap. The negative space suggests a precise connection between audio and neural stimulation. The outside silhouette feels stable and balanced, slightly taller than wide, with modest corner rounding. The two pieces remain separate, and the whole symbol is simple enough for a tiny laser-etched earphone. Avoid making it look like quotation marks, brackets, a pause button or a chain link; use distinctive offset shoulders and careful optical balance.
Pair it with exact lowercase "cymba" in a precise medium-bold neo-grotesk sans serif. Slightly compact proportions, open counters, crisp terminals, double-storey a and a purposeful y. Mature consumer technology, confident and approachable, no bubbly toy lettering. Symbol on left, text on right. Bottom-left sample is standalone symbol.

Design direction: INSTRUMENT. A typographic identity with NO separate symbol. Exact uppercase text "CYMBA". Create a highly refined bespoke wordmark with gently extended proportions, sturdy medium-bold strokes, slightly squared bowls with soft continuous corners, and a cohesive family of five letters. The C has a wide opening with horizontal terminals; Y has a precisely balanced fork; M has vertical stems and a deep central valley; B has generous clear counters; A has a normal attached crossbar. Give the M/Y relationship a subtle distinctive rhythm. All five letters are fully readable, whole and unbroken. Letterspacing is deliberate and compact enough to feel like a physical product badge. The result should feel contemporary and engineered, with the permanence of excellent industrial equipment, without mimicking any existing brand. No excessive tracking or decorative cuts. Bottom-left sample shows the complete wordmark at small size; bottom-right is the same complete wordmark reversed.

Design direction: UNIT. Create one original geometric CM monogram as a compact single-colour hardware emblem. Combine a softened open C-shaped outer contour with a very simple inner folded M structure, using deliberate shared edges and spacious negative space. Build a strong, balanced, nearly square silhouette, no surrounding box, no shield. The design should feel precise and recognisable even when the letter combination is not consciously noticed. Use at most three simple filled components, a consistent visual stroke weight and soft internal corners. Never create a cube, a hexagon, an infinity loop or a labyrinth. Aim for an elegant maker's stamp suitable for a tiny earbud faceplate.
Pair it with exact mixed-case text "Cymba" in a refined medium-weight humanist sans serif, with compact but natural spacing, gentle squared curves, crisp terminals, and clearly readable letters. The symbol sits left and aligns optically to the wordmark. Bottom-left sample is the standalone emblem. An understated but memorable identity for a serious consumer technology company.
